status_note: 3d-model-pipeline stage 7a (mini-batch 2026-10-20, wave A; editor slot 1, DS-3a 2026-10-21): UE import of the Dr. Watson look-dev run 20261020-h2-lookdev-r3 (profile dr-watson-h2-lookdev/r3: generic h2_bake H2 figure of the bake run 20261020-h2-bake-r3 + UV1 in metres, MatID, Edge, graded BC/ORM; TeamAccent ribbon = the bowler hat band (silk) 0.55 % of the figure, profile dr-watson-h2-lookdev-teamaccent-r3) through the CLI profile skeletal-adopt (normaliser h2-lookdev/1) onto the canonical skeleton /Game/PipelineCandidates/DrWatson/Rig/SK_DrWatson_Skeleton. Revolver in the right hand on weapon.R (UM_HUMANOID_17_v2, 17 bones), the medical bag rigid on hand.L without an own bone (P3-2). MI of /Game/UM/Materials/v2/M_UM_Figure_v2 (UseTeamAccent, UseUV1Metres) with the TeamAccent mask and the look-dev LUT T_UM_MatLUT_Watson as is (UE look-dev iteration 0); base on M_UM_BaseMarker in vertex-mask mode: two-tier sidekick base (0.24 x 0.05 m), the team ring by height (bake r3 textures.team_mask.base_band.height_m [0.003, 0.028] -> vertex mask UM_Mask.R; VertexMaskWeight 1, SideBandWeight 0; HANDBOOK §2.9, W2-c; precedent Beowulf). Teams = the active C-11 palette P1 #E8C06A / P2 #5A7F9F (user decision 'accents + ring'). The brown coat, waistcoat, bowler felt, skin, bag, revolver and the stone base are never dyed. At most 'technically imported'; art acceptance of the model by delegation (stage 4 r3 pass 8.8, evidence/acceptance/20261021-r3/card.json; DS-7 determinism pass, 20261020-h2-bake-r3/reports/determinism-report.json and 20261020-h2-lookdev-r3/reports/determinism-report.json). Rev 2 (UE look-dev r2, 2026-10-21): LUT T_UM_MatLUT_Watson_UE_r2 (silk specular 0.25 / sheen 0.05, leather specular 0.25 / roughness 0.5, skin cavityTintStrength 0.1) applied with ue_hero_lookdev.py apply-mi without re-import (RC-10). Rev 3 (UE look-dev r3, 2026-10-21): LUT T_UM_MatLUT_Watson_UE_r3 (silk bc x0.75, leather_smooth specular 0.35, skin bc x1.2) applied with apply-mi without re-import.
